---
title: "population_age_sex"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(httr)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readr)
  library(tibble)
})

# --- 1) Small helper: call Census API and return a tibble --------------------
census_api_get <- function(base_url, query) {
  resp <- httr::GET(base_url, query = query)
  httr::stop_for_status(resp)

  txt <- httr::content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt)

  # first row is header, remaining rows are data
  header <- raw[1, ]
  dat <- raw[-1, , drop = FALSE]

  out <- as_tibble(dat, .name_repair = "minimal")
  names(out) <- header

  out
}

# --- 2) Common transforms -----------------------------------------------------
region_code_to_name <- function(region_code_int) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    region_code_int == 1L ~ "Northeast",
    region_code_int == 2L ~ "Midwest",
    region_code_int == 3L ~ "South",
    region_code_int == 4L ~ "West",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

sex_code_to_name <- function(sex_code_int) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    sex_code_int == 1L ~ "Male",
    sex_code_int == 2L ~ "Female",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

add_age5_group <- function(df, age_col = "age") {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      age5_start = (.data[[age_col]] %/% 5L) * 5L,
      age5 = if_else(age5_start >= 110L, "110+", str_glue("{age5_start}-{age5_start + 4L}"))
    )
}

# --- 3) Pull years <= 2019 from vintage 2018 "charage" (state rows, then sum to region) ---
# DATE_CODE mapping (for July 1 estimates): year 2010 -> 3, 2011 -> 4, ... 2019 -> 12
# So: DATE_CODE = year - 2007 for 2010..2019
fetch_charage_states_one_year <- function(year, api_key = NULL, vintage = 2018L) {
  if (year < 2010L || year > 2019L) {
    stop("charage (vintage 2018) helper here is set up for years 2010..2019. Got year = ", year)
  }

  date_code <- year - 2007L
  base_url  <- str_glue("https://api.census.gov/data/{vintage}/pep/charage")

  query <- list(
    get       = "POP,AGE,SEX,REGION",
    `for`     = "state:*",
    DATE_CODE = date_code,
    RACE      = 0,  # all races
    HISP      = 0   # both Hispanic origins
  )
  if (!is.null(api_key) && nzchar(api_key)) query$key <- api_key

  census_api_get(base_url, query) %>%
    transmute(
      year   = year,
      region = suppressWarnings(as.integer(REGION)),
      sex    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(SEX)),
      age    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(AGE)),
      pop    = suppressWarnings(as.integer(POP))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(region), region %in% 1:4,
      !is.na(sex), sex %in% c(1, 2),
      !is.na(age), age >= 0, age <= 110,
      !is.na(pop)
    )
}

summarise_to_region_age5_sex <- function(df_states) {
  df_states %>%
    add_age5_group(age_col = "age") %>%
    group_by(year, region, sex, age5) %>%
    summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      region_name = region_code_to_name(region),
      sex_name    = sex_code_to_name(sex)
    ) %>%
    select(year, region, region_name, sex, sex_name, age5, pop)
}

# --- 4) Pull years >= 2020 from vintage 2023 "charv" (region geography exists) ---
fetch_charv_regions_one_year <- function(year, api_key = NULL, vintage = 2023L) {
  if (year < 2020L || year > 2023L) {
    stop("charv (vintage 2023) covers 2020..2023. Got year = ", year)
  }

  base_url <- str_glue("https://api.census.gov/data/{vintage}/pep/charv")

  # Request age-by-sex estimates, at region geography.
  # MONTH=7 and UNIVERSE=R are used in official examples; keep them explicit.
  query <- list(
    get      = "NAME,POP,AGE,SEX",
    `for`    = "region:*",
    YEAR     = year,
    MONTH    = 7,
    UNIVERSE = "R"
  )
  if (!is.null(api_key) && nzchar(api_key)) query$key <- api_key

  census_api_get(base_url, query) %>%
    transmute(
      year        = year,
      region      = suppressWarnings(as.integer(region)),  # from `for=region:*`
      region_name = NAME,
      sex         = suppressWarnings(as.integer(SEX)),
      age         = suppressWarnings(as.integer(AGE)),
      pop         = suppressWarnings(as.integer(POP))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(region), region %in% 1:4,
      !is.na(sex), sex %in% c(1, 2),
      !is.na(age), age >= 0, age <= 110,
      !is.na(pop)
    ) %>%
    add_age5_group(age_col = "age") %>%
    group_by(year, region, region_name, sex, age5) %>%
    summarise(pop = sum(pop), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(sex_name = sex_code_to_name(sex)) %>%
    select(year, region, region_name, sex, sex_name, age5, pop)
}

# --- 5) Main: given years, return region x sex x 5-year-age x year population ---
estimate_population_region_sex_age5_by_year <- function(years, api_key = NULL) {
  years <- sort(unique(as.integer(years)))

  years_charage <- years[years >= 2010L & years <= 2019L]
  years_charv   <- years[years >= 2020L & years <= 2023L]

  part_pre2020 <- if (length(years_charage) > 0) {
    map_dfr(years_charage, ~ fetch_charage_states_one_year(.x, api_key = api_key)) %>%
      summarise_to_region_age5_sex()
  } else {
    tibble(year = integer(), region = integer(), region_name = character(),
           sex = integer(), sex_name = character(), age5 = character(), pop = integer())
  }

  part_2020plus <- if (length(years_charv) > 0) {
    map_dfr(years_charv, ~ fetch_charv_regions_one_year(.x, api_key = api_key))
  } else {
    tibble(year = integer(), region = integer(), region_name = character(),
           sex = integer(), sex_name = character(), age5 = character(), pop = integer())
  }

  bind_rows(part_pre2020, part_2020plus) %>%
    arrange(year, region, sex, age5)
}

# --- 6) Example run -----------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: get an API key from the Census Bureau and paste it here.
# api_key <- "YOUR_KEY_HERE"
api_key <- NULL

years_wanted <- 2016:2023
pop_region_sex_age5_year <- estimate_population_region_sex_age5_by_year(
  years = years_wanted,
  api_key = api_key
)

# View result
pop_region_sex_age5_year %>% print(n = 50)


```
